title: IEP Meeting Prep Request Form
subtitle: Capture meeting notice, current plan, progress evidence, and participant role; confirm family priority and proposed action.
description: IEP Meeting Prep records meeting notice, current plan, progress evidence, participant role, family priority, and proposed action. IEP Meeting Prep evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this iep meeting prep request intake when staff must document meeting notice and current plan. Reconcile progress evidence, participant role, family priority, and proposed action before the iep meeting prep handoff. Use the meeting notice, current IEP, service log, progress-monitoring data, evaluation reports, family agenda, participant list, draft proposal, and prior written notice route. For iep meeting prep live use, check roster. Reconcile the iep meeting prep schedule and actual handoff times. Preserve the iep meeting prep roster and schedule. Record the iep meeting prep handoff time and instructions. Close the iep meeting prep exception queue. Verify iep meeting prep day-of-service timing. Resolve iep meeting prep real-time changes and operating handoff for iep meeting prep. Ask the assigned iep meeting prep reviewer to confirm meeting notice against the organization's policy.

sections.title: IEP Meeting Prep contact and reference
sections.guidance: Assemble meeting notice, current plan, service and progress records, participant roles, family priorities, proposed actions, accommodations, and follow-up questions.

blocks.label: IEP Meeting Prep people and reference

sections.title: IEP Meeting Prep request scope review
sections.guidance: Separate the requested outcome from constraints and optional items.

blocks.label: IEP Meeting Prep request checks
items: Meeting notice is identified for this record
Current plan matches the current request or source
Progress evidence is ready for point-of-use staff
Participant role limits or questions are resolved
Family priority is communicated to the responsible person

sections.title: IEP Meeting Prep decision and response
sections.guidance: Record the authorized response without promising an unapproved outcome.
